Both lints had zero Fatal/Error; all four application/instrumentation APK assemblies, all 14 SDK-configured backup mutation tests, static/security/legacy/browser/vector/design checks and fresh packaged checks passed. Independent final read-only scoped review found zero critical/important/minor findings. Exact enrollment parent9545 push549/PR550 remained in progress at this checkpoint's recorded observation; expected298 is not a pass. Raw source/merge/tree/ordered-parent and job/decoded-result bindings supplement retained publication-pending records.

Original recovery source a8f64672c2017e5020631ba3453cd3a2a4f8a840: Android487 attempt1 genuinely failed :app:packageDebug with underlying cause UNKNOWN. The unchanged source's attempt2 passed; independent PR488 passed. The original failure record remains preserved. Later511 explicit heap evidence applies only to511 and does not diagnose487. Recovery and diagnostic evidence: docs/phase3/RECOVERY_2026_10_03.md.

Remaining Task3: complete supported Native/producer/provider/presentation/buffer manifests, immutable copies, global factory/capability narrowing, combined capacity, legacy cleanup/outer ranked gates, complete Secondary attempts/Cipher/backend integration, encrypted staging/cipher mutation closure/full Native validation. Owned DIRECT still denies before acquisition. Scoped helper tests do not accept complete pipelines.
